question: To Kill a Mockingbird’, an English novel, was written by which of the following authors?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Harper Lee**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

• Harper Lee was an American novelist widely known for her novel **"To Kill a Mockingbird"**.

• The novel was published in **1960** and won the Pulitzer Prize for Fiction in 1961.

• "To Kill a Mockingbird" is renowned for its warmth and humor, despite dealing with serious issues of **rape and racial inequality**.
